en.title: AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md — One-Page House Rules for Coding AI
en.summary: Drop this short file into your project folder so Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex immediately knows how to run tests, where files live, and what never to break.
items: Exact one-line commands to check types, run tests, and build the app
Clear folder rules so the AI doesn't hardcode text in random places
Safety guardrails: never touch secrets or push untested code
en.previewSnippet:
# AGENTS.md — Project House Rules for AI

## 1. Check Your Work Before Finishing
- Check types & syntax: `npm run check`
- Run a single test fast: `npx vitest run src/path/to/file.test.ts`
- Full build & broken-link check: `npm run build`

## 2. Where Things Live
- Put data and copy in `content/*.json` — don't hardcode long text inside UI components.
- Keep chat context clean: search specific lines first instead of reading huge files whole.

## 3. Red Lines
- Keep `/en/*` and `/zh/*` pages in sync.
- Never commit `.env` secrets or unverified links.

zh.title: 给编程 AI 立规矩的 AGENTS.md「项目家规」模板
zh.tag: 复制放进项目根目录即可用
zh.summary: 用 AI 写代码最怕它乱改一通还不自知。把这份不到百行的说明文件放进项目根目录，Claude Code、Cursor 和 Codex 一进项目就知道「文件放哪、改完跑哪条命令自检、哪些红线绝不能碰」。
items: 写清一行就能跑通的自检命令（改完代码让 AI 自己跑测试修报错）
划清目录规矩（防止 AI 把数据硬编码在页面里或者乱改全局样式）
立好安全底线（严禁泄露密钥、严禁塞入没验证过的失效链接）
zh.previewSnippet:
# AGENTS.md — 给编程 AI 看的项目家规

## 1. 每次改完代码必须跑这三步自检
- 检查语法和类型报错：`npm run check`
- 单独跑刚刚修改的测试：`npx vitest run src/xxx.test.ts`
- 完整打包并检查死链：`npm run build`

## 2. 目录规矩（别乱放东西）
- 所有数据统一放在 `content/*.json`，不要把大段文字直接写死在页面组件里。
- 省着点用上下文：先用 `rg` 搜索定位具体行号，别一口气把几千行大文件全读进来。

## 3. 绝对不能碰的红线
- 中文（`/zh/*`）与英文（`/en/*`）页面必须保持同步。
- 严禁提交任何密码密钥（`.env`）或打不开的外部链接。

en.title: SKILL.md — On-Demand Playbook Folder for AI Agents
en.summary: Turn any repeatable workflow into a neat folder. Your AI only reads the 2-line summary upfront and opens the full step-by-step instructions when actually needed — saving 90%+ context space.
items: Clear description telling the AI exactly when to use this skill
Put exact checks and math inside scripts/ so AI doesn't guess
Keep long edge-case docs in references/ to load only when needed
en.previewSnippet:
---
name: release-check
description: Run content checks, build the static site, scan for broken links, and take mobile/desktop screenshots before shipping UI changes.
---
# Pre-Release Check Skill

## Steps
1. Run `node scripts/validate-content.mjs` to catch data mistakes.
2. Run `npm --prefix web run build` to verify all pages build cleanly.
3. Read only the error summary if something fails — don't paste giant HTML files into chat.
4. Check both desktop and 390px phone views before wrapping up.

zh.title: 让 AI 按需翻阅的 SKILL.md「工作说明书」模板
zh.tag: 省 Token 的技能包标准
zh.summary: 如果你把十几份长篇操作手册一股脑塞进提示词，AI 又贵又容易看串行。做成 SKILL.md 文件夹后，AI 平时只看两行目录，真遇到对应任务才翻开这本说明书照着一步步做，省下 90% 脑容量。
items: 开头两行写清「遇到什么情况才翻开这本说明书」（不乱触发）
把算账、格式检查写成现成小脚本放在 scripts/ 里，不让 AI 瞎猜
生僻的细节放在 references/ 附录，只有真遇到特殊情况才去翻
zh.previewSnippet:
---
name: release-check
description: 当需要发布网页改动或更新内容前，自动检查数据格式、打包整站、排查死链并截图验收。
---
# 上线前自动体检技能（Release Check）

## 照这 4 步依次执行
1. 先跑 `node scripts/validate-content.mjs`，确认数据没填漏、视频时间没越界。
2. 再跑 `npm --prefix web run build`，打包整站并自动扫描有没有死链。
3. 如果报错，只看报错提示对应的那几行文件，别把整页网页代码全塞进对话框。
4. 最后分别看一眼电脑端和手机窄屏（`390px`）排版有没有挤歪，确认清爽再收工。

en.title: Pass/Fail AI Quality Checker (Stop Guessing with 1–5 Stars)
en.summary: Don't ask AI to rate answers from 1 to 5 — nobody knows what a '3.5' means. Collect 100 real questions, list common mistakes, and have a judge prompt mark strict PASS or FAIL with proof.
items: Simple spreadsheet method to group your top 4–6 real user complaints
Strict PASS / FAIL judge prompt that checks facts line by line first
Quick agreement check to make sure the AI judge matches your own judgment

zh.title: 防 AI 胡说八道的「全对 / 有错」自动批改模板
zh.summary: 千万别让 AI 给自己的回答打「1 到 5 分」——打 3.8 分到底能不能上线？最管用的土办法是：攒 100 条真实用户提问，让裁判模型先逐句核对原文，全对才算过（PASS），有一句瞎编就算挂（FAIL）。
items: 先用表格记下 50 条真实翻车回答，归拢出最常犯的 4 到 5 种毛病
强制裁判模型「先摆原文证据、最后再判 PASS 或 FAIL」，绝不和稀泥
拿 30 条你自己判过的题目对一下答案，确保裁判眼光和你一致

en.title: Hybrid Document Search Snippet (Keyword + Meaning Together)
en.summary: Pure vector search understands meaning but misses exact product codes, error numbers, and names. Combine exact keyword search (BM25) with vector search in 10 lines of Python.
items: Add a 1-line title/date header to each paragraph before saving so context isn't lost
Merge keyword hits and semantic vector hits cleanly with RRF (k=60)
Let the AI search a second time with better keywords if the first try misses

zh.title: 搜得准、不漏型号的「关键词 + 语义」双路搜索代码模板
zh.summary: 做知识库只用「向量搜索」，搜近义词很灵，但一搜具体的产品型号、报错代码或人名就经常抓瞎。用下面这十几行代码把「字面精确搜」和「按意思搜」合二为一，准确率立竿见影往上跳。
items: 把长文章切段前，给每段开头补一句「来自哪篇文档、哪一章」，防止没头没尾
用十行排名合并代码（RRF），让精确词匹配和意思相近的结果强强联手
允许 AI 第一把没搜全时，自己换个近义词再搜一次

en.title: Consistent-Character AI Video Shot Card
en.summary: Stop AI videos from morphing faces every shot: generate a 3-angle character sheet and lock the first & last still frames first, then tell the video model only how the camera moves.
items: Keep one character reference sheet (front, side, 3/4 view) + fixed lighting
Approve the start frame and end frame as still images before rendering video
Use one simple camera direction per shot (slow push-in, pan left, locked tripod)

zh.title: AI 做视频「主角不换脸、镜头不乱晃」分镜脚本模板
zh.summary: 直接拿一句话让 AI 生成视频，十有八九下一秒主角就变了个人。最稳的专业做法是：先用生图锁死「主角正侧三视图」和这一个镜头的「开头画面、结尾画面」，最后只让视频模型把中间 4 秒动起来。
items: 先备好一张主角正脸/侧脸设定图，固定光线色调，跨镜头绝不换脸
先用图片搞定开头第一帧和结尾最后一帧（画图改起来快，别在慢吞吞的视频里碰运气）
每个镜头只给一个干净的镜头动作（比如：缓慢往前推近、固定三脚架不晃）
